free_tier.stated: No storage figure at all on the free tier. Free accounts get temporary storage with a 10,000-content cap per account ('Free accounts are capped at 10,000 stored contents'); free traffic allowance is '100 GB traffic / 30 days'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: 30 days' | content is deleted after 10 days of inactivity unless it keeps being downloaded; past the storage period content may be moved to cold storage and importing it back requires Premium; most API endpoints (listing, direct links) return error-notPremium; 'Repeatedly exceeding rate limits may result in automatic IP bans'

egress.terms: free plan: '100 GB traffic / 30 days'; 'We never throttle bandwidth' but traffic over the allowance restricts download functionality. Premium removes caps entirely

tooling: REST API at api.gofile.io (documented, CORS, per-endpoint rate limits); rclone backend 'gofile' (Tier 1) but its docs warn 'if you wish to connect rclone to Gofile you will need a premium account'; guest account creation is a single unauthenticated POST
chaining: Unlimited guest accounts created by API call (no email, no human-verification step) x 10,000 files each. Probe-verified; each guest account also brings its own 100 GB/30-day traffic bucket, so fetch load can be sharded by account.
limits_note: content is deleted after 10 days of inactivity unless it keeps being downloaded; past the storage period content may be moved to cold storage and importing it back requires Premium; most API endpoints (listing, direct links) return error-notPremium; 'Repeatedly exceeding rate limits may result in automatic IP bans'
